messages:
alice: Heads-up — planning to enable feature flag cache.batch.v2 tonight at 00:30 UTC. This changes batching strategy + local KV prefetch heuristics. Need quick agreement on rollout gatekeepers and rollback playbook. :eyes:
ben: ack. remind me the main risk vectors? higher mem/GPU, p99 regressions, and edge-case cache misses?
carla: yep. also watch async retry amplification — we saw that in staging when prefetch missed and retried. I suggest cohorts: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, with static wait windows and manual thumbs-up between each.
daniel: +1 on cohorts. add automated fences: if OOMs OR host CPU > 70% for 3m OR p99 latency > 2x baseline -> auto-disable flag. We should implement with a single circuit-stage monitor.
alice: sounds good. proposed concrete checks:
```
- metric: infra/oom.count > 1 per host per 5m -> disable
- metric: model/p99_token_latency > baseline*2 for 3m -> disable
- metric: errors/5xx_rate > 0.5% for 2m -> disable
```
carla: add a tolerance buffer for transient spikes: require condition to hold for 3 consecutive windows. Also pin the canary traffic to non-critical routes: route set "preview" + 10% of mobile-ux only for first two cohorts.
ben: who will own the manual check between 5% and 20%? I can take the 00:40-01:10 UTC slot. daniel take 01:10-01:40?
daniel: I can do the second window. I'll be on pager and will watch dashboards + logs. please post the exact dashboard link.
alice: dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/app/dashboards/cache-batch-v2 (perf, errors, hosts). Will also add a shorttail log filter: `app=runtime level>=error cache.batch.v2`.
carla: code-review ping for the flag gating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5123 — left a few comments about graceful shutdown during rollback.
ben: noted. any infra commands we should keep handy for rapid rollback?
alice: rollback commands:
```
# disable flag for prod
./tools/ffctl set cache.batch.v2 false --env prod --scope global
# quick revert on service side (in case flag flip doesn't propagate)
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-pool -n prod
```
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle job created by alice at 2026-03-17T00:30:00Z — will post status updates in thread. :robot_face:
carla: small ask — can we run a synthetic perf job (10k short prompts) against the canary group right after 0.5% enable? That should catch obvious regressions quickly.
daniel: doing it. i'll start the synthetic run and paste results here. if p50/p95 move > 15% we hold.
alice: final checklist before flip:
- [x] PR merged + CR addressed
- [x] dashboards ready + alert thresholds configured
- [x] rollback commands posted
- [ ] owners assigned for each window (ben, daniel done)
- [ ] synthetic run ready (daniel)
- [ ] ops on standby (carla)
If no objections by 00:20 UTC i'll proceed to enable 0.5%.
ben: no objections from me.
carla: all good.
daniel: ready.
alice: enabling in 10. will update here when flag flips. :thumbsup:
note: Thread covers coordination for feature flag rollout of caching/batching change, includes cohort plan, guardrails, rollback commands, and owners.
